kind: reliability tests for the state file
why: the panel polls and a reviewer can click quickly; the store serialises through a promise chain and writes temp+rename, and that claim had no test

tests.concurrentActions: approve, archive and return issued together on three different artifacts; all three statuses survive a reload
tests.failedActionDoesNotBlock: an action on a missing id rejects, and the action queued behind it still runs and persists
tests.twoInstancesAreLastWriteWins: two Store instances on one file: the later write wins and no locking is claimed — pinned as a test so a future change that appears to make it safe is caught

note: the host loads one store per profile, so the two-instance case cannot occur in normal use; the test exists to keep the limitation explicit rather than to endorse it
assertionAdjusted: the first run expected /Unknown artifact/ while the store says 'Item not found'; the test now matches the real message instead of the message I assumed
